zh: 第1章 引言
en: Chapter 1. INTRODUCTION

zh: 概述
我们走出教堂后，站着谈了一会儿贝克莱主教的巧妙诡辩：他试图证明物质并不存在，宇宙中的一切都只是观念。我说，尽管我们确信他的学说不正确，却无法驳倒它。我永远不会忘记约翰逊那敏捷的回答：他用脚猛踢一块大石头，踢得自己都弹了回来，说：“我就这样反驳它。”——詹姆斯·博斯韦尔
en: After we came out of the church, we stood talking for some time together of Bishop Berkeley’s ingenious sophistry to prove the nonexistence of matter, and that every thing in the universe is merely ideal. I observed, that though we are satisfied his doctrine is not true, it is impossible to refute it. I never shall forget the alacrity with which Johnson answered, striking his foot with mighty force against a large stone, till he rebounded from it – ‘I refute it thus’. James Boswell

zh: 唯物主义与唯心主义是一切哲学的两极，二者的争论已持续了2500年。约250年前，詹姆斯·博斯韦尔与塞缪尔·约翰逊的上述对话，简明地概括了这种对立在哲学和社会层面的复杂性。
en: Materialism and idealism, the twin poles of all philosophies, have contended for 2,500 years. The complexity of their opposition, both philosophical and social, is neatly encapsulated by the above exchange between James Boswell and Samuel Johnson some 250 years ago.

zh: 这场争论发生在18 世纪末，当时英国工业革命正在加速，其基础是迅速发展的数学、物理、化学和工程原理。这些原理反过来威胁到宗教意识形态的古老根基，而宗教意识形态曾是英国统治阶级的基石。
en: This argument took place in the late eighteenth century, as the British Industrial Revolution was accelerating, founded on burgeoning mathematical, physical, chemical and engineering principles. In turn, these principles threatened the age-old bases of the religious ideologies that had been the bedrock of the British ruling classes.

zh: 乔治·贝克莱（1685—1753）是一位爱尔兰圣公会主教，他在18 世纪初试图用哲学而非《圣经》权威来支撑自然神论。如今他被视为绝对唯心主义的奠基人，该学说否认一切物质性。
en: George Berkeley (1685–1753) was an Irish Anglican prelate who, at the start of the eighteenth century, sought to use philosophy rather than biblical authority to buttress deism. He is now seen as a founder of absolute idealism, which denies all materiality.

zh: 詹姆斯·博斯韦尔（1740—1795）是苏格兰人，在启蒙运动时期成年。他的信仰立场多变，从小受加尔文主义熏陶，也曾动过皈依天主教的念头。在爱丁堡大学，亚当·斯密曾给他授课；斯密的经济学对制造业的发展和马克思都有重大影响。博斯韦尔一向交游广泛，甚至曾与临终的伟大怀疑论哲学家大卫·休谟讨论来世是否可能存在，而休谟坚决否认这一观念。博斯韦尔有私人财产维持生活，尽管自我厌弃，仍过着放纵的生活；他最为人所知的身份是约翰逊的传记作者。
en: James Boswell (1740–95) was a Scot who came of age during the Enlightenment. Of fluid persuasion, he was raised a Calvinist and toyed with conversion to Catholicism. At the University of Edinburgh, he was taught, in part, by Adam Smith, whose economics greatly influenced both the development of manufacture and Marx. Always well connected, Boswell even discussed the possibility of an afterlife with the dying David Hume, the great sceptical philosopher, who firmly repudiated the notion. With private means, Boswell led a licentious, if self-loathing, life and is best known as Johnson’s biographer.

zh: 塞缪尔·约翰逊（1709—1784）是一位英国文人，以其权威的英语词典闻名。他言语直率，曾在牛津大学受教育，博览群书，是托利党人，也是圣公会信徒。因此，约翰逊的常识唯物主义竟能穿透那些令博斯韦尔如此困惑的诡辩，实在引人注目。
en: Samuel Johnson (1709–84) was an English man of letters, who is remembered for his authoritative dictionary of the English language. Plain-speaking, Oxford-educated and widely read, he was a Tory and an Anglican. Thus, it is striking that Johnson’s common-sense materialism cut through the sophistries that so perplexed Boswell.

zh: 我们的唯物主义同样以同外部现实的互动为基础，但它当然不像约翰逊的唯物主义那样迁就唯心主义。事实上，本书旨在捍卫原子论唯物主义和机械唯物主义，反对唯心主义的解释。
en: Our materialism is equally grounded in interaction with external reality, though certainly not as accommodating of idealism as Johnson’s. Indeed, the intention of this book is to defend atomistic and mechanical materialism against idealist accounts.

zh: 我们的论述采取历史视角，从古希腊原子论者一直到当代，将其视为贯穿科学与哲学学科的哲学分化。我们关心的是这种分化所带来的政治哲学后果。
en: Our extended presentation is from a historical perspective, from the Greek atomists to the current day, as a matter of philosophical differentiation running across scientific and philosophical disciplines. We are interested in exploring the political-philosophical consequences of such differentiation.

zh: 我们的批判立场来自卡尔·马克思的唯物主义学说，而不是马克思主义的全部遗产——后者并非铁板一块。因此，我们选择推演并追随马克思本人的思路；我们认为，这种思路已经在他关于希腊原子论的博士论文中成形。因此，我们的诠释学是对马克思本人方法的一种模仿。我们拆解辩证法与唯物主义的统一体，试图把二者作为独立但常常结合或交叉的思想线索来追踪，并根据所讨论的作者和学科，分析这两个概念本身的辩证关系。
en: Our critical stance is informed by the materialist doctrine of Karl Marx rather than the entire legacy of Marxism, which is not a monolithic phenomenon. Hence, we chose to extrapolate and follow Marx’s original line of thinking, which, we argue, already takes shape in his doctoral dissertation on Greek atomism. Our hermeneutics is, therefore, a type of mimesis of Marx’s own approach. While we dismantle the unity of dialectics and materialism, we try to follow their developments as independent yet often united or intersecting strands of thought, and analytically examine the dialectics of the two notions themselves, depending on the authors and disciplines discussed.

zh: 本书追踪若干贯穿时间的平行线索：
en: The book covers several parallel threads which are traced through time:

zh: 原子观念在数世纪中如何既变化又保持同一。我们把它视为真正唯物主义与带有唯心主义色彩的唯物主义——或隐蔽唯心主义的唯物主义——之间的分界点，这在哲学以及数学和计算等科学中都存在；

children: How the idea of atoms has both changed and remained the same across the centuries.

en: We see this as the point of delineation between materialism proper and materialism with a touch of idealism, or materialism as covert idealism, both in philosophy and the sciences, which include mathematics and computing;

zh: 逻辑的发展及其在多位思想家著作中与“辩证法”的关系。我们在这里探究其政治影响，以及意识形态如何影响科学沿唯物主义与唯心主义这一分界作出的认识论选择。

children: The development of logic and its relationship to ‘dialectics’ in the work of multiple thinkers.

en: Here we explore the political repercussions as well as the influence of ideology on the epistemological choices made in sciences along the materialism/idealism divide;

zh: “无中不能生有”这一原则反复出现。它源于古希腊哲学，并在守恒定律的发展中不断被重述和激活，最终被理解为这些定律都源于对称性。这一形而上学困境隐秘地存在于科学、政治哲学和经济学中。作为欧洲观念史组织结构的支柱之一，这种无意的、常常不经意间存在的返祖现象，塑造了我们今天所知的当代科学、技术和社会经济理论的很大部分；

children: The repeated appearance of the principle that nothing comes from nothing.

en: This originates in ancient Greek philosophy and is reprised and animated in the development of conservation laws, culminating in the understanding that these all derive from the properties of symmetry. This underpinning metaphysical dilemma is insidiously present in the sciences, political philosophy and economics. As one of the pillars of the organization of the European history of ideas, this unintended, often inadvertently present, atavism has moulded much of what we now know as contemporary science, technology and socio-economic theory.

zh: 物理学、生物学以及对人类社会的反思中的时间性质；后一类反思主要见于哲学，也见于社会科学。对贯穿这些学科的时间观念作诠释学考察，能够为历史唯物主义提供一种新的理解，使之摆脱 diamat 的教条，即苏联所确立的辩证唯物主义的教条。

children: The nature of time in physics, biology and reflections on human society, mainly in philosophy but also in the social sciences.

en: A hermeneutics of the ideas of time running through these disciplines offers a fresh view on the idea of historical materialism, disentangled from the dogmas of the diamat, that is, dialectical materialism as set in the USSR.

zh: 我们的焦点是列宁和爱因斯坦批判的显性唯心主义，以及影响苏联diamat 的隐性黑格尔式唯心主义。从古希腊思想中唯物主义的起源开始，我们探讨它在牛顿物理学和牛顿世界观中的复兴。我们说明马克思如何借鉴原子论者，为他批判黑格尔唯心主义提供基础。然后考察历史唯物主义的兴起和生物学在达尔文主义下的转型。我们进一步探讨达尔文主义更广泛的认识论影响，这种影响可见于马克思主义以及若干科学中的其他哲学流派。
en: Our focus is the explicit idealism criticized by Lenin and Einstein and the implicit Hegelian idealism that influenced Soviet diamat. Starting with the origins of materialism in ancient Greek thinkers, we explore its revival in the physics of Newton and the Newtonian world view. We show how Marx drew on the atomists to provide the basic foundation for his critique of Hegelian idealism. We then look at the rise of historical materialism and the Darwinian transformation of biology. We further explore the wider epistemological effect of Darwinism, which can be traced in Marxism and other philosophical strands and schools of thought in a number of sciences.

zh: 19 世纪末20 世纪初，围绕原子爆发了激烈的哲学争论，如今这常被遗忘。植根于科学解释模型中的唯心主义认识论，阻止人们把原子论接受为超出边缘推测的东西。diamat 教条及其核心的黑格尔权威，对苏联科学尤其是数学和计算的发展产生了抑制作用。在自称唯物主义认识论的最深层信条中，唯心主义内核影响了20 世纪社会主义世界技术发展的步伐。我们以此为例，说明科学作为隐蔽哲学的影响：正如马克思所论证的，这种隐蔽哲学会不可避免地产生一种唯心主义，并影响技术以及更广泛科学发展的路径。这是科学受自身形而上学选择之苦的症状，即使它明确把自己定位为反形而上学。矛盾的是，我们在苏联社会主义科学传统中比在20 世纪至21 世纪西方科学发展中更注意到这种影响。
en: The late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries saw intense philosophical controversy over atoms, something which tends to be forgotten now. Idealist epistemologies, embedded in scientific models of interpretation, prevented the acceptance of atomism as anything more than a marginal speculation. The dogma of diamat, and the authority of Hegel at its centre, had an inhibiting effect on the development of sciences, particularly mathematics and computing, in the Soviet Union. The idealist core in the deepest tenets of what purported to be a materialist epistemology affected the pace of technological development in the socialist world of the twentieth century. We explore this as an illustration of the effect of science as covert philosophy, the latter unavoidably yielding a form of idealism, as argued by Marx, on the pathways of technological and broader scientific development. This is a symptom of science suffering from its own metaphysical choices, even when it positions itself decisively as anti-metaphysical. Paradoxically, we note such an effect more in the tradition of Soviet socialist science than in Western twentieth to twenty-first century scientific development.

zh: 原子能开发出来以后，已没有人怀疑原子的真实存在，但在1900年前后，原子的实在性还广受质疑。我们追溯这场哲学争论的政治和理论背景。我们考察人们对于原子论的“机械论”世界观中所蕴含的“粗糙的物质性”（马克思，《资本论》第1卷第1章）的反感；这种物质性与一切存在所依据的任何“空灵本原”（ἀρχή）相对。随后我们论证，正是这种反感，使那些公认属于唯物主义的哲学和科学仍然留着一扇后门，其中也包括那些甚至不愿在唯心主义与唯物主义之间作出形而上学选择的学科。“空灵本原”这一隐喻指向从古希腊到当代数学和计算机科学的一系列观念。这既可能表现为一个悬而未决的问题，也可能表现为干脆坚持“一切都是语言，外部现实并不存在”——至少不是以一种应当被认真对待的方式存在；后结构主义反复念诵的口号便是一例。
en: After the development of atomic energy, nobody doubted that atoms were real, but back in 1900 their reality was widely questioned. We trace the political and theoretical background to this philosophical controversy. We identify the aversion towards ‘coarse materiality’ (Marx, Cap. V. 1, Ch. 1) nesting in the ‘mechanistic’ world view of atomism, as opposed to any ‘ethereal’ principle (ἀρχή) of all existence. We then argue that this aversion is why the admittedly materialist philosophy and sciences kept an open back door, including those which did not even bother to make the metaphysical choice of idealism versus materialism. The metaphor of ‘ethereal principle’ refers to a plethora of notions dating from Greek antiquity to contemporary mathematics and computer sciences. This can range from an open question to simply maintaining the position that ‘all is language and the outside reality does not exist’, at least not in a way that should count, as in the post-structuralist mantra, for example.

zh: 方法
我们对唯物主义的论述尽可能以一手资料为依据；原始材料不是英语时，则使用译本。我们基本上避免与那些阐释我们所引哲学家和科学家的人展开讨论。我们也基本上避免采用范围更广的历史叙述，除非找不到一手资料，或这些叙述提供了没有争议的概述。
en: Our account of materialism is drawn, as far as possible, from primary sources, using translations where original material is not in English. We have mostly avoided engaging with interpreters of the philosophers and scientists we cite. We have also mostly avoided wider historical accounts, except where we could not locate primary sources or where they offered uncontroversial summaries.

zh: 我们承认自己的“西方”哲学取向，也承认未介入当代科学史领域的争论。我们希望为理解唯物主义带来一种新视角，引导读者像我们努力做到的那样，直接接触原始论证。如果有人指责我们无知或修正主义，那就由他们去吧。当然，我们乐于接受纠正，并进一步讨论自己的立场，所秉持的是达成共同理解的精神，而不是争胜计分的经院式论辩。
en: We acknowledge our ‘Western’ philosophical orientation and our lack of engagement with contemporary debates in the history of science. We wish to bring a fresh perspective to the understanding of materialism, which leads our readers to engage directly with original arguments as we have tried to do. If we are accused of ignorance or of revisionism, then so be it. We are happy, of course, to be corrected and to further debate our positions in the spirit of coming to a shared understanding rather than point-scoring scholasticism.

zh: 为了始终聚焦唯物主义在哲学和自然哲学中的发展，我们有意作出了一些省略。尤其是，我们不讨论那些“重大”的哲学问题：我们从哪里来？为什么在这里？为什么是这样？又将走向何方？
en: To maintain the core focus on the development of materialism in philosophy and natural philosophy, we have made a number of intentional omissions. In particular, we do not address the ‘big’ philosophical questions: where do we come from; why are we here; why are we like this; where are we going?

zh: 除非其他世界观曾直接促进或阻碍唯物主义，我们不予讨论。尤其是，总体而言，我们很少谈及信仰或宗教。最后，我们也不讨论这里阐述的唯物主义所具有的道德、伦理、社会或直接政治后果。也许最重要的一项省略，是没有探讨意识的性质。我们对唯心主义的拒斥，必然使我们把意识视为物质系统的一种属性，无论这种系统是否属于人类。
en: We do not consider other world views, other than where they directly contributed to or hindered materialism. In particular, overall we say little about belief or religion. Finally, we do not consider the moral, ethical, social or immediate political consequences of the materialism we elaborate. Perhaps the most significant omission is that of the nature of consciousness. Our rejection of idealism necessarily leads us to situate consciousness as a property of material systems, whether or not human.

zh: 请注意，引文均照原文逐字引用，不对其中诸如带有性别色彩的语言作出评论。斜体沿用原文。人物的生卒年往往直接取自维基百科。
en: Note that quotations are verbatim, without comment on, say, gendered language. Italics are as in the original. Dates of birth and death are often purloined from Wikipedia.

zh: 各章
下面逐章简要概述本书内容。
en: We next briefly survey the book’s contents, chapter by chapter.

zh: 第2章 对古希腊所提供的概念材料及其开创的跨千年交流的语文学与哲学考察
en: Chapter 2. Philologico-philosophical examination of the conceptual material proffered by Greek Antiquity and the trans-millennial exchanges it has foregrounded

zh: 我们指出希腊哲学中唯心主义与唯物主义之间张力的根基：这种张力历经数世纪仍然存在，其基础前提仍与古代确立的前提相同。亚里士多德和原子论者既试图使变化成为可思考的对象，又仍困在必须遵守埃利亚学派“无中不能生有”原则的要求之中。原子论者成功地表明，“虚空”或“虚无”是物质的一个方面，一切存在的本原都是物质性的——即不可分割的物质量，atomoi，也就是“不可切分者”；伊壁鸠鲁派的卢克莱修·卡鲁斯的著作尤其如此。
en: We identify the foundations of the tension between idealism and materialism in Greek philosophy: a tension that has persevered throughout the centuries while retaining the same grounding premises identified in Antiquity. Both Aristotle and the atomists remain trapped in observing the Eleatic Principle, ‘nothing comes from nothing’, while trying to enable a thought of change. The atomists succeed, most notably in the work of the Epicurean Lucretius Carus, in demonstrating that ‘the void’ or ‘nothingness’ is an aspect of matter and that the principle of all existing is material – the indivisible quantity of matter, the atomoi or the uncuttables.

zh: 第3 章古典原子论
en: Chapter 3. Classical atomism

zh: 我们考察从原子论者到18 世纪法国机械学派完成牛顿世界观的历程。阿基米德式机械唯物主义对牛顿影响巨大，牛顿由此提出自然哲学的方法。法国学派通过能量守恒和最小作用量原理扩展了牛顿力学。
en: We explore the atomists to the completion of the Newtonian world view by the eighteenth-century French mechanical school. Archimedean mechanical materialism was enormously influential on Newton, who enunciated a methodology of natural philosophy. The French school elaborated on Newton’s mechanics by postulating the conservation of energy and the principle of least action.

zh: 第4 章辩证法、唯物主义与变化：从伊壁鸠鲁经亚里士多德到马克思
en: Chapter 4. Dialectics, materialism, change from Epicurus to Marx via Aristotle

zh: 我们重建辩证法作为一种本体论范畴在欧洲哲学中出现的过程，并将其与古代的起点区分开来：在古代，尤其在亚里士多德关于我们今天称为逻辑学的论著中，辩证法原本是一种方法或本体论范畴。我们在共产主义的 diamat 学说中所见的唯物辩证法，其起源可以追溯到黑格尔，却不能再上溯到更早的时代。马克思对这一术语的使用更接近亚里士多德，而非受黑格尔启发的 diamat。我们把辩证法和唯物主义视为马克思思想中的两个不同范畴，也在马克思的思想来源——原子论和黑格尔——中将二者区分开来。
en: We reconstruct the appearance of dialectics as an ontological category in European philosophy, as opposed to its origin as a category of method or ontology found in Antiquity, and in particular in Aristotle’s writings on what we now call logic. The origins of materialist dialectics, as we find it in the communist doctrine of diamat, can be traced back to Hegel but not further in the past. Marx’s use of the term is closer to that of Aristotle’s than to the Hegel-inspired diamat. We look at dialectics and materialism as two distinct categories in Marx, but also in what served as Marx’s inspiration, namely, atomism and Hegel.

zh: 第5 章历史唯物主义与机械唯物主义
en: Chapter 5. Historical and mechanical materialism

zh: 我们介绍应用于社会和生物变化的唯物主义。历史唯物主义被视为斯密与恩格斯各自独立作出的共同发现。马克思的《资本论》受到牛顿关于守恒定律，以及作用力与反作用力大小相等、方向相反的观念的影响。恩格斯将历史与生物学中目的论的消解归功于马克思和达尔文二人各自独立的贡献。我们把达尔文之前以人类为中心的目的论生物学解释，与达尔文提出的因果模式相对照。我们考察达尔文主义如何取消人与动物之间的截然区分，并考察人类的情感和行为特征如何像其生理特征一样，有着深厚的哺乳动物根源。原子论在19世纪初复兴。道尔顿等人的化学进展，使之成为化学研究的实际基础。这又为理解热、压力等现象奠定了基础；蒸汽革命正建立在对这些现象的理解之上，而这也促成了热力学关键概念的发展。
en: We introduce materialism as applied to social and biological change. Historical materialism is treated as the independent co-discovery of Smith and Engels. Marx’s

was influenced by Newtonian ideas of conservation laws and of equal and opposite actions and reactions. Engels credited Marx and Darwin with jointly and independently displaced teleology from history and biology. Pre-Darwinian anthropocentric teleological accounts of biology are contrasted with the mode of causality proposed by Darwin. We consider Darwinism’s abolition of the human as distinct from the animal, and how human traits of emotion and behaviour, as much as physiology, have deep mammalian roots. Atomism revived at the start of the nineteenth century. Advances in chemistry by Dalton and others established it as the working basis of chemistry. This was the basis for understanding heat, pressure, etc., on which the steam revolution was based, and led to the development of the key concepts of thermodynamics.

zh: 第6 章唯心主义的复兴与回应
en: Chapter 6. Idealist reprise and responses

zh: 我们讨论20 世纪物理学中唯物主义与唯心主义争论的关键分界。原子论复兴恰逢社会主义兴起，一些国家担心新的原子论世界观会鼓励无神论唯物主义和社会主义。杰出原子论者玻尔兹曼遭到以马赫为首的实证主义/工具主义学派强烈反对。1905 年，爱因斯坦发表三篇论文，共同彻底改变我们对自然界的理解，并决定性地驳斥马赫主义。这些进展导致量子力学，并通过海森堡学派导致一种对新物理学的唯心主义解释，该解释大量借鉴马赫主义。
en: We cover the key dividing lines in the debate between materialistic and idealistic schools of twentieth-century physics. The revival of atomism coincided with the growth of socialism, and there was, in some countries, a fear that atheistic materialism and hence socialism would be encouraged by the new atomistic account of the world. The prominent atomist Boltzmann experienced strong opposition from the positivist/instrumentalist school of philosophy and natural philosophy headed by Mach. In 1905, Einstein published three papers that together revolutionized our understanding of the natural world and decisively repudiated Machism. These advances though led to quantum mechanics and, via the Heisenberg school, an idealist interpretation of the new physics that drew heavily on Machism.

zh: 第7 章逻辑与唯物主义
en: Chapter 7. Logic and materialism

zh: 亚里士多德认识论中三段论逻辑与辩证法的统一，在宗教改革前深刻影响欧洲思想以及天主教框架下的教育。此后，英国传统拒绝逻辑和辩证法，转向归纳、经验主义和唯物主义；随后逻辑被恢复并置于形式化基础上。数学的逻辑基础似乎触手可及。
en: The unity of syllogistic logic and dialectics in Aristotle’s epistemology heavily influenced European thought and hence education, framed by Catholicism, until the Reformation. Thereafter, following the rejection of both logic and dialectics in favour of induction, empiricism and materialism in the British tradition, logic was rehabilitated and placed on a formal footing. It seemed that the logical foundations of all mathematics were within reach.

zh: 第8 章逻辑与辩证唯物主义
en: Chapter 8. Logic and dialectical materialism

zh: 黑格尔对亚里士多德思想中辩证成分的强调，深刻塑造了19世纪及20世纪初马克思主义者对逻辑的态度。1925年恩格斯的《自然辩证法》出版后，苏联围绕辩证唯物主义内部形式主义（此时已与逻辑相联系）与辩证法之间的平衡，展开了激烈斗争。这导致一类被混同归并为“孟什维克化的唯心主义”的思想受到严厉谴责，也导致公式化的“diamat”的形成；直至斯大林去世，这种 diamat 一直规定着官方共产主义哲学的面貌。
en: Hegel’s emphasis on the dialectical component of Aristotelian thought strongly framed the attitude of nineteenth- and early twentieth-century Marxists towards logic. Following the publication of Engels’

in 1925, there was intense struggle in the Soviet Union over the balance in dialectical materialism between formalism, now associated with logic, and dialectics. This led to the anathematizing of a conflated Menshevizing Idealism and the formulaic ‘diamat’ that defined official communist philosophy until the death of Stalin.

zh: 第9 章逻辑危机与反形式主义的顶峰
en: Chapter 9. The crisis in logic and the apotheosis of anti-formalism

zh: 20世纪初，逻辑学的进展使其能够将自身形式化，由此发现了其核心深处的悖论。与此同时，这些进展也为计算机的发展奠定了基础，并对我们如何将现实刻画为彼此建模的反映系统，产生了深远影响。
en: In the early twentieth-century, advances in logic enabling it to formalize itself led to the identification of profound paradoxes at its heart. At the same time, these advances underpinned the development of computers, with profound implications for how reality may be characterized as reflective systems that model each other.

zh: 第10 章语言、自动机与意义
en: Chapter 10. Language, automata and meaning

zh: 我们把可计算性作为唯物主义的统一框架，整合模型论、语言游戏、自动机理论和形式语言。马尔可夫的构造主义被视为对直觉主义的唯物主义重构，为现实的有限主义解释提供基础。
en: We present computability as a unifying framework for materialism, integrating model theory, language games, automata theory and formal languages. Markov’s constructivism is considered as a materialist reformulation of intuitionism, underpinning a finitist interpretation of reality.

zh: 第11章 辩证唯物主义与随机唯物主义
en: Chapter 11. Dialectical and stochastic materialism

zh: 我们阐述信息论的含义：信息是客观的、物理的，完全独立于人类意识。我们探讨信息与随机性的关系，表明表面偶然性受规则支配。最后，我们探讨量、质和相变概念。
en: We elaborate on the implication of information theory, which is that information is something objective and physical, quite independent of human consciousness. The relationship between information and randomness is explored, demonstrating that apparent chance is governed by rules. Finally, we explore the notions of quantity, quality and phase changes.
